apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

Coming from an old nightly? It is now a separate app (ARMSX2 Nightly) that installs
beside the stable app. The old nightly cannot install a stable over itself, because
Android refuses that version downgrade, so to return to stable: back up your saves
and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install a stable APK.

## What's new
- iOS: drop the pad layout INI protocol
- iOS: drop @unchecked Sendable from two main actor classes
- iOS: clamp through the range helper instead of three copies
- iOS: use std::string::starts_with for the path prefix test
- iOS: use the documents directory helper that already exists
- iOS: build the bridge with ARC
- RetroAchievements: a compact use-global link instead of a big button
- Touch controls: say the game must be restarted to switch player
- Translations: in-game menu help and ROV description match the English
- Translations: Polish and Turkish complete
- Translations: Brazilian Portuguese and Thai complete
- Translations: Kurdish complete
- Translations: Persian and Indonesian complete
- Translations: Simplified and Traditional Chinese complete
- Translations: Russian and Ukrainian complete
- Translations: Arabic and Spanish complete
- Translations: Vietnamese complete
- Translations: Japanese and Korean complete
- Translations: French and Italian complete
- Translations: fill in 7,580 strings that only existed in English
- Translations: no em dashes, cut-off strings finished (other 9 languages)
- Translations: no em dashes, cut-off strings finished (first 10 languages)
- Settings text: no em dashes, and three cut-off strings finished
- Settings: the GameDB Fixes help no longer says to turn it off
- Touch controls: an Always setting, and they can play as Player 2
- Touch: Auto mode ignores controller noise
- Touch: auto-hide counts every held control, and removal lets go
- Touch: gestures no longer kill the multi-touch buttons
- Controls: put the pressure sliders where people look for them
- Touch editor: wrap the chips instead of squeezing them off screen
- Touch: Half-Screen Sticks no longer swallow the multi-touch buttons
- Touch: turn the digitizer to the display before scaling by it
- Touch: pressure per macro, and the P button's amount in the editor
- Touch: Half-Screen Sticks can keep the on-screen left stick
- Second screen: a switch in the in-game menu, and a hotkey
- OSD: device temperatures on their own line
- RetroAchievements: every option per game, set from the RetroAchievements screen
- Touch controls: the volume keys no longer hide them
- Input: a trigger-bound hotkey fires once, whichever way the pad reports it
- Boot intro: a Preview button, and copy the video off the main thread
- Texture packs: send pack submissions to our Discord
- RetroAchievements: a standard setting, so it can be on for some games and off for others
- Renderer: texture packs under the resolution, Coalesce Render Passes out of the quick menu
- Quick menu: capture a GS dump from the Session page
- Game database: show what it sets for a game, and let the game's own settings win
- App: let the user choose their own boot intro
- Touch: three glide modes -- Follow, Hold first, Hold all
- Give up the GL context from the thread that owns the ring
- One deployment target for the core and its dependencies
- cmake: name HarfBuzz when FreeType resolves to an archive
- GS: link the shaderc archive wherever it is what was found
- deps: an opt-in static mode for the Linux dependency set
- A GLES context is not the same thing as an Android build
- The core's own log is the frontend's, so send it the info lines too
- Build the libretro core for iOS and tvOS
- Give the GS thread a GL context of its own to render on

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260919...4497c92942e244477767f4f4b9185b78509554c2
